levels.name: Open
levels.description: Public content is consistently accessible with a verified low-friction method.

levels.name: Tuned
levels.description: Public but requires source-specific adapter, headers, endpoint choice, pagination or rendering strategy.

levels.name: Sensitive
levels.description: Public but access is unstable, rate-limited, challenged or block-prone.

levels.name: Authenticated
levels.description: Authorized API/login/session is required; cadence follows granted policy.

levels.name: Restricted
levels.description: Automated acquisition is unsuitable or not approved; metadata/manual/approved channel only.
